step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Actors/Devices: Electric Vehicle (UserConsumerIOT) sending telemetry, Fleet Operator (UserCompanyAgent) receiving alerts and dashboards.
2. Identify AWS Services on whiteboard: ELB (ELB), Broker running on EC2 (EC2), Kinesis Data Stream (KinesisDataStream), Lambda (Lambda), SNS (SNS), S3 (S3), Glue (Glue), Athena (Athena).
3. Map connections/edges based on physical arrows on whiteboard:
   - Electric Vehicle -> ELB (MQTT/TCP/IP)
   - ELB -> Broker
   - Broker -> Kinesis
   - Kinesis -> Lambda
   - Lambda -> SNS -> Fleet OP (Alerting flow)
   - Lambda -> S3 (Data ingestion flow)
   - S3 -> Glue -> S3 (ETL / Curation flow)
   - S3 -> Athena -> Fleet OP (Analytics / Dashboard flow).

nodes.name: Fleet OP

nodes.name: S3

nodes.name: Glue

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Queries S3 data to power dashboards for fleet operators
